AgenticAutofillRemoteBrowser.title: Agentic Autofill remote browser.
AgenticAutofillRemoteBrowser.description: If true, marks this browser as operated by an Agentic Autofill partner's agent: the Agentic Autofill API is available, the welcome page is not shown, and every tab starts in agentic mode.

CredentialIntelligence.title: Credential Intelligence settings.
CredentialIntelligence.description: If configured, it turns on the Credential Intelligence feature of the 1Password extension.
